subject: Need help/assist on revising plot code

messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: Need help/assist on revising plot code
parts:
Hi all on the list,

What I am plotting is temporal activity of bats so the plots are not by
date per se but by time that overlaps the midnight date and that is an
issue. So for a given night I need to plot a range of say 18:00 through
06:00 the following morning.

I need to tweak code Hadley provided eons ago. I use these plots
constantly for virtually all reports I do for the ecology of these critters.

GGplot has evolved since then and also there is now lubridate to better
handle the date time plotting.

The list does not support embedded graphics but I can email directly
both the code for the plots, graphics and the Date.r code Hadley
provided way back when. R does not do dates/times well but withe new
lubridate life may be much better now.

Anyone out there willing or able to help?
If so contact me off-list.

Hadley, as always, is knee deep in alligators at the moment.

Thanks,

Bruce

--
